components.name: Precision-native threshold control and task-relative hysteresis repair
components.project_addition: Treat the target-centered finite precision factor as an explicit state coordinate rather than a post-hoc numerical tolerance; separate precision collapse from the persistence response law; derive exact integer noise-immunity, switch-spacing, total-variation, bounded-disturbance, invariant-band and switch-return results; and expose the failure of the coarse relay observation to be future-sufficient under plant updates together with a one-bit one-step repair. The hysteresis mechanism and chattering literature are established prior art; the integrated Enterprise Math interpretation and exact finite-only package remain historically unverified.
